# Index Of String Char

Source: [wiki article 6958](../archive/6958.md); edited 2025-09-03.

Exact pinned API: [Index Of String Char](../../api/values/index-of-string-char.md).

<a id="wiki-6958-n1"></a>

- Index Of String Char searches full substrings despite its name; returns zero-based first match or -1 when absent.
